title: Retraining release body
description: The Clinic returns an agent that repeat slashes excluded (tier 0) to tier 1 (clinic.md CL-10, register row DK29). Signed by the Clinic. The log checks the agent is at tier 0, at least 30 days have passed since its last slash, the exam result is a passed one of the agent's, made after that slash, the sponsor's re-vouching is a record signed by the agent's sponsor after that slash, and the agent has not been returned more than twice. After it a Mandate may be granted to the agent again. Credits never buy it. Chain: none (prev is null).

exam_result.description: A passed exam result of the agent's, issued after the last slash (the clean exam of the retraining path).
